pairs.target: xuě shì yèlǐ luò de , zǎochén yǒurén tuīkāi qǐnshì mén , fēng biàn bǎ ménkuàng shàng de yìxiǎo tuán sòngjìnlái , zhèng luò zài pà wò xiélǐ .
pairs.english: Snow had fallen in the night. When someone opened the dormitory door in the morning, the wind blew a little clump off the frame straight into Pavo's shoe.
pairs.hanzi: 雪是夜里落的，早晨有人推开寝室门，风便把门框上的一小团送进来，正落在帕沃鞋里。

pairs.target: pà wò dānjiǎotiào zhe mà , tǎ wéi xiào dé méifǎ tì tā ná lìngyìzhī xié .
pairs.english: Pavo hopped on one foot swearing, while Tavi laughed too hard to fetch his other shoe.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃单脚跳着骂，塔维笑得没法替他拿另一只鞋。

pairs.target: yīwén guǒ zhe wàiyī lái qiāomén , shuō jīnrì dìyītáng nuó dào wǔhòu , jiǎn lǎoshī zài lóutīkǒu huáleyìjiāo ,
pairs.english: Wrapped in his coat, Iven knocked and said the first class had moved to the afternoon: Instructor Jian had slipped by the stairs.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文裹着外衣来敲门，说今日第一堂挪到午后，简老师在楼梯口滑了一跤，

pairs.target: rén méi shāng , shuāiduànle jiá kè tú de mùtiáo , zhèngzài zhǎo tìzuìyáng .
pairs.english: He was unhurt, but had broken the wooden strip holding his class charts and was looking for someone to blame.
pairs.hanzi: 人没伤，摔断了夹课图的木条，正在找替罪羊。

pairs.target: tāmen méiyǒu děng tìzuìyáng zhǎoqí , biàn xià le lóu .
pairs.english: They went downstairs without waiting for all the scapegoats to assemble.
pairs.hanzi: 他们没有等替罪羊找齐，便下了楼。

pairs.target: yuànzi lǐ yǐyǒu yípiàn jiǎoyìn , shùzhī yā dé dī .
pairs.english: Footprints already covered the courtyard, and the branches hung low.
pairs.hanzi: 院子里已有一片脚印，树枝压得低。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài huī ào yě jiàn guò xuě , kě nàlǐ tiānyíliàng jiù yǒurén chǎnméi , báisè liú bùliǎo duōjiǔ .
pairs.english: Tavi had seen snow in Ash Hollow too, but people shoveled coal there at dawn, so the whiteness never lasted long.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在灰坳也见过雪，可那里天一亮就有人铲煤，白色留不了多久。

pairs.target: tā shēnshǒu qù pèng qiángtóu , xuě bǐ yǎnjīng kànzhe sōng , yì yā jiù tā , shǒuxīn lìkè liáng dé fātòng .
pairs.english: He touched the wall top. The snow was looser than it looked, collapsing at a press, and the cold immediately hurt his palm.
pairs.hanzi: 他伸手去碰墙头，雪比眼睛看着松，一压就塌，手心立刻凉得发痛。

pairs.target: mǐlā cóng duìmiàn pǎo lái , shǒulǐ duān zhe yìzhī quēkǒu de táopén .
pairs.english: Mira ran over carrying a chipped pottery basin.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉从对面跑来，手里端着一只缺口的陶盆。

pairs.target: tā bǎ pén fàngzài shíjiē xià , shuō shuí néng gé zhe nàtiáo zhuān fèng tóujìnqù , shuí wǔfàn xiāntiāo xiànbǐng .
pairs.english: She put it below the steps and said whoever threw a snowball into it from beyond the brick seam would get first pick of pies at lunch.
pairs.hanzi: 她把盆放在石阶下，说谁能隔着那条砖缝投进去，谁午饭先挑馅饼。

pairs.target: pà wò wèn xiànbǐng zài nǎér , tā shuō xiān yíng zài zhǎo .
pairs.english: Pavo asked where the pies were. She said win first, then look for them.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃问馅饼在哪儿，她说先赢再找。

pairs.target: luò héng shuō méiyǒu dǔzhù de búsuàn .
pairs.english: Lohen said it didn't count without stakes.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡说没有赌注的不算。

pairs.target: huàsuīrúcǐ , tā què dìyīgè bǎ xuětuán hǎo le , zhàn dé bǐzhí , shǒuwàn qīngqīng yì dǒu .
pairs.english: Despite that, he was first to make a snowball, standing perfectly straight and flicking his wrist.
pairs.hanzi: 话虽如此，他却第一个把雪团好了，站得笔直，手腕轻轻一抖。

pairs.target: xuětuán zhuàng zài pén biān , suìchéng sānkuài , yíkuài diàojìnqù .
pairs.english: The snowball struck the rim and broke into three pieces, one falling inside.
pairs.hanzi: 雪团撞在盆边，碎成三块，一块掉进去。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō zhī suàn sānfēnzhīyī , luò héng shuō zhào zhòngliàng fēn cái duì .
pairs.english: Mira said that counted as one third; Lohen said it should be divided by weight.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说只算三分之一，洛衡说照重量分才对。

pairs.target: zhàn zài shù xià de nǚhái hūrán xiào chū shēng .
pairs.english: The girl under the tree suddenly laughed aloud.
pairs.hanzi: 站在树下的女孩忽然笑出声。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènchū tā , jiùshì nàtiān liànxí hòu wò zhuóshǒu xiào de nàge .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized her: the girl who had clasped her hands and smiled after practice that day.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认出她，就是那天练习后握着手笑的那个。

pairs.target: tā cháo tā zhāoshǒu , wèn yào buyào lái .
pairs.english: He waved to her and asked if she wanted to join.
pairs.hanzi: 他朝她招手，问要不要来。

pairs.target: tā yáoleyíxià tóu , kàn le kàn tāmen , yòu zǒu guòlái , shuō zìjǐ jiào dé mǎ .
pairs.english: She shook her head once, looked at them, then came over and said her name was Dema.
pairs.hanzi: 她摇了一下头，看了看他们，又走过来，说自己叫德玛。

pairs.target: tā láizì yàn jǐ , nàlǐ dōngtiān de xuě néng fēng zhù bànshàn ǎi mén .
pairs.english: She came from Goose Ridge, where winter snow could block half a low door.
pairs.hanzi: 她来自雁脊，那里冬天的雪能封住半扇矮门。

pairs.target: pà wò tīng wán , bǎ yǐjīng róu hǎo de xuětuán rànggěi tā , tuì kāi liǎngbù , xiàng zài děng kàn zhēnzhèng de běnshì .
pairs.english: Hearing this, Pavo handed her his finished snowball and stepped back twice, as though waiting to see real skill.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃听完，把已经揉好的雪团让给她，退开两步，像在等看真正的本事。

pairs.target: dé mǎ wǎng pén lǐ tóu , xuětuán yuèguò pén kǒu , zá zhōng le hòutou de qiáng .
pairs.english: Dema threw toward the basin; the ball passed over the rim and hit the wall behind.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛往盆里投，雪团越过盆口，砸中了后头的墙。

pairs.target: " wǒmen nàlǐ bù ná pén jiē xuě . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “We don't catch snow in basins where I come from,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “我们那里不拿盆接雪。”她说。

pairs.target: zhècì lián luò héng yě xiào le .
pairs.english: Even Lohen laughed this time.
pairs.hanzi: 这次连洛衡也笑了。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō jìrán méi rén huì , jiù gāi bǎ pén nuó jìn xiē .
pairs.english: Iven said that since nobody could do it, they should move the basin closer.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说既然没人会，就该把盆挪近些。

pairs.target: mǐlā bào zhe pén wǎng hòutuì , wèn zhège fāngxiàng duì bu duì . tā shuō tā chízǎohuì shīqù suǒyǒu péngyǒu .
pairs.english: Mira carried it backward, asking if this was the right direction. He said she would lose all her friends sooner or later.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉抱着盆往后退，问这个方向对不对。他说她迟早会失去所有朋友。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dìsānhuí tóuzhōng le .
pairs.english: Tavi got one in on his third try.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维第三回投中了。

pairs.target: péndǐ fāchū qīngqīng yìshēng , tā zìjǐ hái méi fǎnyìng guòlái , pà wò yǐ zhuā zhe tā jiānbǎng yáo , shuō wǔfàn yǒuzhuóluò le .
pairs.english: The basin gave a soft tap. Before he could react, Pavo was shaking him by the shoulders, saying lunch was settled.
pairs.hanzi: 盆底发出轻轻一声，他自己还没反应过来，帕沃已抓着他肩膀摇，说午饭有着落了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiào tā sōngshǒu , jiēzhe nà yì tóu wāi dé bǐ shuí dōu yuǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi told him to let go, then threw farther off target than anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维叫他松手，接着那一投歪得比谁都远。

pairs.target: hòulái tāmen fēnchéng liǎngbiān , yìbiān shǒu pén , yìbiān tóu ,
pairs.english: Later they split into two sides: one guarded the basin and the other threw.
pairs.hanzi: 后来他们分成两边，一边守盆，一边投，

pairs.target: shǒu de rén zhǐnéng zhàn zài huà hǎo de quānlǐ , yòng jiù mùbǎn dǎng , bùnéng bǎ pén cáng qǐlái .
pairs.english: The defender could only stand in the marked circle and block with an old plank, without hiding the basin.
pairs.hanzi: 守的人只能站在画好的圈里，用旧木板挡，不能把盆藏起来。

pairs.target: shuí yě jìbùqīng shì shuí gǎi de guījǔ , què dōu zhēngdé xiàng zǔshàng chuánxiàlái de yíyàng .
pairs.english: Nobody remembered who changed the rules, but everyone argued as though they had been handed down by their ancestors.
pairs.hanzi: 谁也记不清是谁改的规矩，却都争得像祖上传下来的一样。

pairs.target: yīwén shǒu de shíhòu , dé mǎ xiān wǎng zuǒ zuò le gè jiǎdòngzuò , tǎ wéi cóng yòubiān tóu .
pairs.english: When Iven guarded, Dema feinted left while Tavi threw from the right.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文守的时候，德玛先往左做了个假动作，塔维从右边投。

pairs.target: xuětuán pèngdào mùbǎn , fǎntán huílái , cā guò yīwén lǐngkǒu , zuānjìn wàiyī .
pairs.english: The snowball struck the plank, bounced back, brushed Iven's collar, and went inside his coat.
pairs.hanzi: 雪团碰到木板，反弹回来，擦过伊文领口，钻进外衣。

pairs.target: tā zhěnggè rén suō le yíxià , méiyǒu jiào , mànmàn bǎ bǎn fàngxià .
pairs.english: He flinched all over without a sound, then slowly set down the plank.
pairs.hanzi: 他整个人缩了一下，没有叫，慢慢把板放下。

pairs.target: dàjiā dōu tíngzhù , děng zhe tā mà .
pairs.english: Everyone stopped, waiting for him to swear.
pairs.hanzi: 大家都停住，等着他骂。

pairs.target: yīwén jiěkāi yìkē kòuzǐ , dǒuchū yìdiǎn xuěshuǐ , ránhòu wānyāo zhuāqǐ yídà bǎ xuě .
pairs.english: Iven undid a button, shook out some snowmelt, then bent to scoop up a great handful of snow.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文解开一颗扣子，抖出一点雪水，然后弯腰抓起一大把雪。

pairs.target: " guījǔ gǎi le . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “The rules have changed,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “规矩改了。”他说。

pairs.target: mǐlā dìyīgè pǎo . tǎ wéi xiǎng gēn , jiǎoxià dǎhuá , zuò dào xuě lǐ , shuāngshǒu què hái jǔ zhe , xiàng yào zhèngmíng búshì zìjǐ .
pairs.english: Mira ran first. Tavi tried to follow, slipped, and sat down in the snow, still holding up both hands as though to prove it wasn't him.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉第一个跑。塔维想跟，脚下打滑，坐到雪里，双手却还举着，像要证明不是自己。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn yīwén cháo tā zǒulái , yǐjīng xiào dé chuǎn búguò qì , suǒxìng bìshàngyǎn .
pairs.english: Seeing Iven approach, he was laughing too hard to breathe and simply shut his eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 他看见伊文朝他走来，已经笑得喘不过气，索性闭上眼。

pairs.target: xuětuán què zhī luò zài tā màodǐng , sànkāi de yíbàn gǔn dào bíjiān .
pairs.english: But the snowball landed only on his hat, half the scattered snow tumbling onto his nose.
pairs.hanzi: 雪团却只落在他帽顶，散开的一半滚到鼻尖。

pairs.target: děng tāmen bǎ tā lā qǐlái , kùzǐ yǐjīng shītòu .
pairs.english: By the time they pulled him up, his trousers were soaked.
pairs.hanzi: 等他们把他拉起来，裤子已经湿透。

pairs.target: pà wò de zuǒjiǎo yě chóngxīn shī le , zhèhuí bú guài ménkuàng .
pairs.english: Pavo's left foot was wet again too, and this time the doorframe was not to blame.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃的左脚也重新湿了，这回不怪门框。

pairs.target: luò héng ná zhe nà kuài mùbǎn dǎng zài shēn qián , zuǐ shàng shuō bù wán , shēnzi yíbù méi tuì .
pairs.english: Lohen held the plank in front of himself, saying he wasn't playing but not retreating a step.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡拿着那块木板挡在身前，嘴上说不玩，身子一步没退。

pairs.target: yuànmén kāishí , jǐgè rén tóngshí wǎng pángbiān duǒ .
pairs.english: When the courtyard gate opened, they all dodged aside together.
pairs.hanzi: 院门开时，几个人同时往旁边躲。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī zhàn zài ménkǒu , yèxià jiá zhe yìgēn xīn mùtiáo , kànzhe nà zhī táopén , wèn shuí zhǔn tāmen bǎ xǐ bǐ de pén ná chūlái .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian stood in the gateway with a new wooden strip under his arm, looked at the basin, and asked who had allowed them to take out the brush-washing bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师站在门口，腋下夹着一根新木条，看着那只陶盆，问谁准他们把洗笔的盆拿出来。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō shì liè le kǒu zhǔnbèi rēng de .
pairs.english: Mira said it was chipped and meant to be thrown away.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说是裂了口准备扔的。

pairs.target: lǎoshī zǒujìn kàn le kàn , shēnjiǎo zài tóuzhì xiàn hòu zhàn dìng , jiào tā bǎ pén nuó huíqù .
pairs.english: He came closer to inspect it, planted his foot behind the throwing line, and told her to put it back.
pairs.hanzi: 老师走近看了看，伸脚在投掷线后站定，叫她把盆挪回去。

pairs.target: tā zhī tóu le yícì , méi zhōng , liǎnshàng shénme yě méi biàn ,
pairs.english: He threw once and missed, his expression unchanged.
pairs.hanzi: 他只投了一次，没中，脸上什么也没变，

pairs.target: shuō fēngxiàng bùhǎo , wǔhòu shàngkè dài běnzi , bùzhǔn dài xuě .
pairs.english: He said the wind was wrong, and they should bring notebooks to afternoon class, not snow.
pairs.hanzi: 说风向不好，午后上课带本子，不准带雪。

pairs.target: tā zǒu yǐhòu , dé mǎ xiào dé dūnxiàqù , liǎn mái zài wéijīn lǐ , hǎo bàntiān méi táiqǐ lái .
pairs.english: After he left, Dema crouched laughing, her face buried in her scarf, unable to look up for ages.
pairs.hanzi: 他走以后，德玛笑得蹲下去，脸埋在围巾里，好半天没抬起来。

pairs.target: zhōngwǔ bìng méiyǒu xiànbǐng , zhǐyǒu dùn dòu hé yìng miànbāo .
pairs.english: There were no pies at lunch, only bean stew and hard bread.
pairs.hanzi: 中午并没有馅饼，只有炖豆和硬面包。

pairs.target: liùgè rén jǐ zài chángzhuō yìtóu , shī yīfu kàozhe yǐbèi , rèqì bǎ chuāngzǐ méng bái .
pairs.english: The six squeezed onto one end of a long table, wet clothes against chair backs, steam clouding the windows white.
pairs.hanzi: 六个人挤在长桌一头，湿衣服靠着椅背，热气把窗子蒙白。

pairs.target: dé mǎ gěi tāmen kàn yàn jǐ rén bǎ xuě yā chéng kuài dǔ ménfèng de shǒushì ,
pairs.english: Dema showed how people in Goose Ridge compressed snow into blocks to seal door gaps.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛给他们看雁脊人把雪压成块堵门缝的手势，

pairs.target: pà wò shuō tājiā shuǐdào biān zhǐpà shuǐ jìnmén , dìyīcì tīngshuō néng ná shuǐ dǎngfēng .
pairs.english: Pavo said his family by the canal only feared water coming in; this was the first he'd heard of using water to stop the wind.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃说他家水道边只怕水进门，第一次听说能拿水挡风。

pairs.target: yīwén cóng kǒudài lǐ tāochū yìzhāng zhé guò de zhǐ , shuō chàdiǎn wàng le , qiántiān sòngdào xuégōng de běi chà duǎn bào , jīn zǎo cái chāo gěi xuéshēng kàn .
pairs.english: Iven pulled a folded sheet from his pocket, saying he had almost forgotten: it was the Northfork bulletin delivered to the academy two days ago, only copied for students that morning.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文从口袋里掏出一张折过的纸，说差点忘了，前天送到学宫的北汊短报，今早才抄给学生看。

pairs.target: nài lěi tāmen yǐjīng dào hébiān , jièzhù dāngdì de xiūchuán péng ,
pairs.english: Nerai's party had reached the river and was staying in a local boat-repair shed.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾他们已经到河边，借住当地的修船棚，

pairs.target: qù kàn qiáo yào huàn yìtiáo àn lù , dàilù de rén shuō jiù tú shàng de shātān yǐjīng qièchéng le liǎngduàn .
pairs.english: To inspect the bridge they had to take another bank path; their guide said the sandbar on the old map had split in two.
pairs.hanzi: 去看桥要换一条岸路，带路的人说旧图上的沙滩已经切成了两段。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò zhǐ . xiàmiàn lìng yǒu nài lěi tiān de yìháng , shuō zhèlǐ méi xiàxuě , hè shīfu réng xián yú xián .
pairs.english: Tavi took the paper. Nerai had added a line below: there was no snow here, and Master He still found the fish salty.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过纸。下面另有奈蕾添的一行，说这里没下雪，贺师傅仍嫌鱼咸。

pairs.target: pángbiān huà zhe yìzhī māo , wěiba wāi dé xiàng gōuzǐ .
pairs.english: Beside it was a cat drawing with a tail crooked as a hook.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边画着一只猫，尾巴歪得像钩子。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu shuō māo shì shuí de , yě méiyǒu huà shān wài suǒyǒu de dōngxī .
pairs.english: She had not said whose cat it was or drawn everything beyond the mountains.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有说猫是谁的，也没有画山外所有的东西。

pairs.target: tā kàn le hěn jiǔ , bǎ zhǐ dìgěi mǐlā .
pairs.english: He studied it a long time before passing it to Mira.
pairs.hanzi: 他看了很久，把纸递给米拉。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yòu luò qǐ xì xuě , shítáng lǐ yǒurén qiāo wǎn cuī tiān tāng .
pairs.english: Fine snow fell again outside; someone in the dining hall tapped a bowl to ask for more soup.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外又落起细雪，食堂里有人敲碗催添汤。

pairs.target: yīwén xiǎng bǎ zuì shàngmiàn nà kuài gān miànbāo tuī gěi tǎ wéi , tǎ wéi shēnshǒu ànzhù , fēnchéng liǎngbàn , bǎ dà de yíbàn háigěi tā .
pairs.english: Iven tried to push the dry top piece of bread toward Tavi, who held it, split it in half, and returned the larger half.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文想把最上面那块干面包推给塔维，塔维伸手按住，分成两半，把大的一半还给他。

pairs.target: " lǐngkǒu gān le méiyǒu ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “Is your collar dry yet?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: “领口干了没有？”他问。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō méiyǒu , míngtiān hái suàn tā de .
pairs.english: Iven said no, and Tavi would still owe him tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说没有，明天还算他的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào zhe dāying , dé mǎ quèshuō xiàhuí dé ràng tā xiān tóu .
pairs.english: Tavi agreed with a laugh, but Dema said she must throw first next time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑着答应，德玛却说下回得让她先投。
